worker_target_description: Study 3, main depletion analysis: chocolate-cake versus fruit-salad choice after recalling a delegated versus independently made decision; logistic regression, PDF p. 7 / printed p. 409.
worker_notes: Only es_value_o is assigned. The p. 7 locator identifies the Study 3 main depletion test; the Study 4 material on that page is introduction/method, not its results. The printed statistic is chi-square 5.46 for a logistic-regression analysis, with same-test p < .03. No log odds ratio or logistic coefficient is printed in this result. Retained the printed statistic without conversion; 70.6% and 31.6% are printed choice shares, not log odds ratios. PDF page 7 was rendered and visually inspected. Unassigned fields are null placeholders and do not update previously verified data.
